description: Deterministic project safety rules for AI Module 2. Risk is based on the approved procedure and hazard type, never on AI 1 model confidence.
low_before_you_begin: Park the vehicle safely away from moving traffic.
Apply the parking brake and keep the vehicle stationary.
Stop if you feel unsure or notice anything unsafe.
caution_before_you_begin: Park the vehicle safely away from moving traffic.
Switch off the engine unless the approved step only asks you to observe an existing dashboard indication.
Keep away from traffic and moving vehicle parts.
Continue only if you understand the step.
Stop immediately if you feel unsure.
caution_warning: This check requires additional care. Stop immediately if you notice smoke, a fuel or burning smell, leakage, excessive heat, exposed wiring, or anything unsafe.
high_warning: Do not attempt further inspection or repair. Keep a safe distance from the vehicle when necessary and request professional assistance.
incomplete_branching_note: The source supplies an ordered step and result options but does not define result-specific branching. Source order is preserved; no repair outcome is inferred.
